inference_input.ordering: one unique ticker/session_date; shared exchange sessions in ascending date order; prediction date is final supplied session
inference_input.missing_policy: reject missing, nonfinite, duplicate, unknown ticker, incomplete rolling history, missing same-date SPY, or missing peer-group inputs; no imputation
inference_input.availability: all input bars and SPY return must be available by decision time; after-close only

return.preprocessing: StandardScaler fitted on training rows only
return.class_definition: same-date relative tertiles of eligible future 20-session returns; ties retained together; minimum 45 peers
return.probabilities: predict_proba for three classes; uncalibrated; must be finite and sum to one

risk.target: annualized realized volatility of future sessions t+1 through t+20
risk.boundaries: training-only one-third and two-thirds quantiles; Low <= first, Medium <= second, otherwise High; save actual values with final artifact
risk.probabilities: predict_proba for three classes; uncalibrated; must be finite and sum to one

final_fit_gate.hyperparameters: select only on a frozen chronological inner validation interval using return mean daily Spearman and risk macro F1; tie keeps declared grid order; no final value is preselected
unresolved: final fitting and inner validation dates

rules: freeze candidate grids and feature variants before fitting
purge 20-session target windows at every train/validation/calibration boundary
fit every transformer and calibrator only on earlier permitted rows
reserve a distinct later chronological block to score the complete tuned pipeline
do not use the viewed 2026 benchmark evaluation as an untouched AI-model test
record fold metrics, probability quality, High-risk recall and High-to-Low errors
do not promote a tuned candidate from its best fold alone
